title: Vivi2D Project Format through v11
$comment: Machine-readable freeze artifact approved by Spec Freeze Amendment 1. It models the v1-10 wire shape and the two v11 asset modes as exclusive branches. I-3, I-4, I-6 through I-8, projected uniqueness, hash/size equality, reachable embedded-asset closure, canonical byte size, version minimization, clip-mask uniqueness, and mask-invert capability derivation require semantic validation.

requires.$comment: IDs must be unique. Entries must be sorted by UTF-8 byte order of id; requiredFor uses fixed render,edit order.

oneOf.title: ViviFileDataWireV11Embedded
oneOf.$comment: I-4/I-11: every extension blobRef must be a directly embeddable blob and its transitive closure must exactly equal embeddedAssets. Atlas bytes are carried directly in image and never create atlas-only embeddedAssets entries.

Sha256HexV11.$comment: Wire input accepts either hex case. Producers emit lowercase; consumers normalize for equality and storage lookup under Spec Freeze Amendment 1.

RawBase64V11.$comment: Raw base64 only; data URLs are rejected by the pattern. Decoded byte/hash checks are semantic.

mediaType.$comment: maxLength is a structural approximation; Stage 2 enforces 1..255 UTF-8 bytes.

then.$comment: For blob, objectAddress must equal contentSha256; equality is semantic.

mediaType.$comment: maxLength is a structural approximation; Stage 2 enforces 1..255 UTF-8 bytes.

oneOf.$comment: Extension data is intentionally an arbitrary recursive JSON object, so schema-object T-STRICT does not apply to its application-defined keys. Duplicate map keys and nesting/token/byte limits are codec-stage checks.

ReferencedExtensionMapV11.$comment: The JCS UTF-8 representation of the whole extensions map must not exceed 16777216 bytes. Every envelope's requiredCapabilityId must map to requires and registry classification is semantic.

EmbeddedExtensionMapV11.$comment: The JCS UTF-8 representation of the whole extensions map must not exceed 16777216 bytes.

ViviEmbeddedAssetV11.$comment: Decoded byte length and SHA-256 must equal sizeBytes/contentSha256.

EmbeddedAssetMapV11.$comment: Each key suffix must equal the entry contentSha256. Reachability and per-ref size/hash equality are semantic invariants.

oneOf.$comment: Legacy raw see-through metadata accepted by the current packages/model parser and normalized on read.

clipMasks.$comment: Stage 2 requires ordered unique layerId values and automatic vivi.cap.maskInvert@1/render derivation when any edge is inverted. Ordinary save canonicalizes an all-false edge array to clipMaskIds; opaque/local duplicate paths preserve the received representation.

ProjectDataLegacyV1To10.$comment: Legacy v1-10 requiredness follows the current packages/model ProjectDataSchema parser while the common shape remains closed.

ProjectDataCanonicalV11.$comment: Canonical v11 requiredness follows packages/model's ProjectData TypeScript interface.

ProjectDataShapeV1To11.$comment: Closed common 17-field ProjectData shape. Requiredness is selected by the containing wire-version branch because the legacy parser and canonical v11 TypeScript contract intentionally differ.
